knowledge_graph.title: Garmin Forerunner 265
knowledge_graph.description: The Garmin Forerunner 265 is a GPS running watch with up to 13 days of battery life in smartwatch mode, sleep tracking, 5 ATM water resistance, and no subscription required.

answer_box.title: Garmin Forerunner 265
answer_box.snippet: Garmin Forerunner 265 offers up to 13 days of battery life, advanced sleep tracking, and 5 ATM water resistance. No subscription required.
